data.body: 2026-09-26 (2nd) desktop/src-tauri/target cleanup: removed compaction-build (14.669 GB) + codex-fixed (2.227 GB), full cargo caches referenced by nothing, plus 163 copied aworkit-desktop.exe files (13.057 GB) from per-run dirs; target went 40.8 -> 10.85 GB (304 dirs, 36,771 files). KEPT deliberately: release/ (live target, holds the running app), the 8 non-rebuildable debug snapshot exes, target-root QA binaries that scripts actually read (native-mcp-approval.mjs defaults to target/aworkit-mcp-approval-qa.exe; docs cite target/performance/aworkit-qa.exe), and all ~300 native-*/web-*-qa-* run dirs - their reports/screenshots are cited evidence in docs (context-compression.md, context-continuation-performance.md, agent-prefix-cache.md, background-process-windows.md, desktop-layout.md, workspace-instructions.md). Do not blanket-delete those. Prevention: the smoke scripts copyFile the ~85 MB app binary into every run dir; hardlink or clean it up instead.
